scope_limits: PR3015's exhaustive search over all 2-4-gate restore-phase blocks (its Stack2979 harness) is not reproduced; the census here covers one class (adjacent same-target pairs rewritten in R1's way with the three frames chosen as described) on both words.

The frames of the three new gates are checked for legality and priced as given; whether a different frame assignment of the whole word gives a lower paid profile (a frame re-solve) is not decided here.

The native chains, the bootstrap, the complete admission and the outer release of PR3015 (author-run, evidence/ in its package) are not rerun; kappa is checked as arithmetic on the complete profile under the inherited moment model (M(b) = sum n_r r (73/r)^b / (73 W)), with the inherited 24-digit grid and the -1e-46-1e-70 margins.
The fixed-inventory fractional cap certificate (RELAX-CAP.json) is not re-derived.

PR3018's journal is applied and priced; its sign proof, its own geometry checker and its physical legality claims beyond rules R-a..R-e are not re-derived.  The composed endpoint was computed here (about 18:40 UTC) without having read PR3021, which published the same composition at 2026-10-16 18:21 UTC and has priority; it is checked against PR3021's finite records; PR3021's fresh native/admission/outer release is author-run and not rerun here.
The window semantics and the free interleaving of independent replica controllers are inherited modelling assumptions (as in PR2804/PR2865).
